subject: Consolidated account migration & SLA elevation request
messages:
From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@novacorp.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: ProcureOps <procure@novacorp.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal coming up — want to consolidate accounts + SLA uplift

Hi Mateo,

Hope you’re well. Our renewal for the three NovaCorp teams (analytics, search, and payments) is approaching in January. We’d like to consolidate the teams under a single account with predictable capacity and formally upgrade to Redwood’s Premium SLA. Main asks: 1) p95 latency targets for production gen routes, 2) an agreed burst credit bucket for seasonal spikes, and 3) a single invoicing flow (one PO).

Attached is a short list of technical questions from our infra team (NovaCorp_SLA_Redesign_Questions.xlsx). Can we schedule a short call this week with engineering + SE to validate the latency targets and sizing? Procurement (cc’d) will need pricing and a DocuSign link to start their internal approval.

Thanks — appreciate a clear path so we can finalize budget for Q1.

—
Sarah Lim
Head of Platform Engineering, NovaCorp
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal coming up — want to consolidate accounts + SLA uplift

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear brief and the attachment. Happy to take the lead here. Proposed next steps (short plan):

- Quick tech alignment call (30 min) this Thu 11:00am PT to walk the XLS and confirm p95 targets / sequence length assumptions (Aditya to join).
- Draft a Mutual Action Plan (attached: Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.docx) that maps milestones: account consolidation cutover, capacity reservation, SLA start date, and invoicing cadence.
- Pricing options: (A) Premium SLA (standard) — 12-month term, 99.9% availability, p95 gen latency target 120ms on reserved pool, burst credits = 300k token credits/month; (B) Premium+ — 12-month term, extended burst to 750k token credits and 24/7 priority oncall. I’ll share a one-page pricing summary after the call.

I’ve looped Marissa (Enterprise) and Monica (CS) so we can align on implementation and onboarding. If procurement wants a soft copy of contract terms to start redlines, we can attach a term sheet and a DocuSign envelope once we agree option.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0123
From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@novacorp.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@novacorp.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procure@novacorp.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 11:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal coming up — want to consolidate accounts + SLA uplift

Thanks Mateo — that plan looks good. Procurement had two quick asks after reviewing the MAP: 1) We need a 15-month pricing option (to align with our fiscal year) and 2) language clarifying data retention and audit log exports (SOC2 scope). Can you share a draft term that reflects a 15-month term with the Premium SLA and the standard audit/export clause?

Also, for the consolidation cutover: our infra team needs a 72-hour maintenance window where we’ll reroute keys and one small downtime batch. Can Redwood confirm support coverage for that window (we expect the Premium SLA to accommodate planned maintenance without penalty if it's scheduled and notified 7 days prior).

If you can send a draft term sheet and a DocuSign link, procurement will begin internal approvals.

Regards,
Tom Nguyen
Senior Procurement Manager, NovaCorp
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@novacorp.com>, Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal coming up — want to consolidate accounts + SLA uplift

Tom / Sarah — thanks, and great notes. Action items we completed and included in the attached package (Redwood_Premium_SLA-terms_v1.pdf):

- Added a 15-month term option (pricing row included for Premium and Premium+).
- Clarified data retention and audit-log export language (SOC 2 scope, 90-day export window, S3-compatible delivery).
- Confirmed maintenance handling: scheduled maintenance with 7-day notice is excluded from SLA penalty; unplanned incidents remain covered. We’ll also commit a named on-call contact for the 72-hour consolidation window.

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached terms and the pricing table.
2) If OK, we’ll send a DocuSign envelope for the 15-month Premium option (or Premium+ if you prefer) — link below.
3) Marissa and Monica will coordinate the onboarding dates and the consolidation runbook after signature.

DocuSign (provisional): https://docusign.com/txn/ABC1234-sign
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/NOVA-2026-345

Attachments: Redwood_Premium_SLA-terms_v1.pdf; Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.docx

Thanks — looking forward to getting NovaCorp consolidated and on the Premium path.

—
Mateo Alvarez
